title: SaaS Application Discovery & License Right-Sizing
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (discover SaaS apps + right-size seats across sign-in/usage telemetry; moderate config, pilot-to-prod).
hook: Find the SaaS you're overpaying for — and right-size every seat
problem: SaaS sprawl is the new shadow IT: teams buy apps directly, seats are bought and forgotten, and nobody has a full picture of SaaS spend. This solution gives you a repeatable way to discover SaaS applications and right-size licenses — surface what's actually in use from sign-in and usage telemetry, identify unused and duplicate seats, consolidate overlapping tools, and bring SaaS spend under control.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the SaaS sprawl problem, discovery via Entra ID sign-ins / app telemetry, the right-sizing levers (reclaim, consolidate, downgrade), and the ongoing review cycle.
Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID sign-in/usage data, app owner contacts, SaaS admin access where available, a spend baseline) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: discover SaaS apps and usage, map owners and spend, identify unused/duplicate/overlapping seats, right-size and consolidate, set a recurring review, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — SaaS app/usage discovery (Entra ID sign-ins), seat-utilization validation, a SaaS spend and right-sizing report, safe remediation (flag/reclaim candidates), and a review-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to discover SaaS applications and right-size licenses — surface real usage from sign-in telemetry, reclaim unused and duplicate seats, consolidate overlapping tools, and bring SaaS spend under control. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A repeatable way to discover SaaS applications and right-size licenses — surface real usage, reclaim unused and duplicate seats, consolidate overlapping tools, control SaaS spend.
meta_description: Discover SaaS apps and right-size licenses: usage from Entra ID sign-ins, reclaim unused/duplicate seats, consolidate overlapping tools, control SaaS spend. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: SaaS spend under control — apps discovered, unused and duplicate seats reclaimed, overlapping tools consolidated — with a recurring review to keep it that way, proven on a pilot before you scale.
